estimand: Counterfactual backend substitution on two archived first-response cohorts. Planners originally saw the GPT-5 package; the rebuilt packages share its plan interface.

build_compute.billing: ChatGPT subscription, separate from metered OpenRouter calls

confirmation.rule: Within each repeat compare contract with its ordinary-prompt sibling and the original library on all 20 primary targets (strict increases). The held-out response cohort must also have all 20 observed, no net decline versus original, and at least one newly passed target in each contract repeat.

limitations: The original builder used a different model and information. A primary gain shared by both new prompts supports a rebuilt backend, not a prompt-specific advantage. Both cohorts cover the same project and the same task IDs. Fixed example 1 is a separate control.
